comments.overrides: Pin @cloudflare/workers-types across the tree to the version the worker code is written against; the vitest-pool-workers toolchain otherwise pulls a newer one whose stricter binding types can break existing src types (types-only; runtime unaffected). Pin @modelcontextprotocol/sdk to exactly 1.29.0 so the tree holds a single copy: agents@0.19.x declares exactly 1.29.0 as well, and a second copy beside it makes McpServer's private _serverInfo incompatible at the type level (types-only). Keep the exact version rather than a ^ range: 1.30.0 is already published (2026-07-27), and since this overrides entry propagates the direct spec across the tree, ^1.29.0 would carry every copy onto a version never checked against agents@0.19.x.
